description: This is a comprehensive documentation markdown file describing the 'CompositeInput' HAL interface, including its overview, implementation details, system context, capabilities, data flow, state machines, error handling, and configuration examples. It serves as a specification/reference for developers integrating or maintaining this HAL component.

classes.name: ICompositeInputManager
classes.description: Manager interface for discovering composite input ports and platform capabilities.

classes.name: ICompositeInputPort
classes.description: Interface for controlling and querying individual composite input ports.

classes.name: IPortEventListener
classes.description: Callback interface for port connection, signal, and video mode events.

classes.name: IPortTelemetryListener
classes.description: Callback interface for telemetry and metrics updates.

classes.name: PlatformCapabilities
classes.description: Defines platform-wide feature flags and capabilities.

classes.name: PortCapabilities
classes.description: Defines port-specific features and supported properties.

classes.name: PortStatus
classes.description: Represents current port status including connection, signal, and video mode.

classes.name: SignalStatus
classes.description: Enum representing signal states like NO_SIGNAL, UNSTABLE, STABLE, NOT_SUPPORTED.

classes.name: VideoResolution
classes.description: Information about video resolution and format, including interlacing.

classes.name: PortMetrics
classes.description: Telemetry data such as lock time, drop counts, and uptime.

classes.name: PropertyKVPair
classes.description: Key-value pair used in property batch operations.

classes.name: PropertyMetadata
classes.description: Metadata describing property types, read-only status, and descriptions.

methods.name: getPlatformCapabilities
methods.description: Returns platform-wide capabilities and feature support.

methods.name: getPortIds
methods.description: Returns list of available port IDs.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Returns interface for specific port, given its ID.

methods.name: getCapabilities
methods.description: Returns the capabilities of a given port.

methods.name: getPortInfo
methods.description: Returns metadata about the port (name, description).

methods.name: getPropertyMulti
methods.description: Batch queries multiple properties at once.

methods.name: getMetrics
methods.description: Retrieves current telemetry metrics if supported.

methods.name: setActive
methods.description: Activates or deactivates the port for video presentation.

methods.name: registerEventListener
methods.description: Registers a callback for event notifications (connection, signal, video mode).

methods.name: registerTelemetryListener
methods.description: Registers a callback for periodic telemetry updates.
